_comment: A worked nerva.goal-contract.v1 draft — exactly what a decision card carries when Nerva asks to be allowed a night of work. Every field is required by GoalDraft: an approval that named none of them would be an approval of nothing in particular. Note 'reads-well' declares no probe_ref: it grades as unverifiable rather than being dropped, so an unprobed criterion can never quietly become a pass. 'plan' is the ordered work the owner is approving alongside the goal — every step's kind is inside scope_kinds, which is enforced when the card is built rather than discovered at 3am; a goal approved with an empty plan and no model planner proposes nothing at all rather than improvising. The fingerprint is over this exact payload — an edit between the card and the execution, the plan included, cannot ride the approval given for it.

example.title: Prepare the Q3 board brief
stop_conditions: the source financials change after the draft is started
a required data source is unreachable for more than an hour

checks.describe: a brief file exists under the reports directory for this quarter
every figure in the brief matches the source ledger
the brief is under two pages and free of placeholders

example.deliverable: one brief under <data root>/reports, two pages or fewer

plan.summary: collect the Q3 figures from the source ledger
draft the two-page brief from those figures
save the brief under the reports directory
